title: mentha aquatica f. pedunculata
intro: Mentha aquatica f. pedunculata, commonly known as water mint, is a variety of water mint that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This perennial herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary properties, and is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mentha aquatica f. pedunculata include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which are responsible for its aromatic and medicinal properties.
